g.text: Zeta Retail wants saved cards for B2B before renewal
Neha forwarded a note from Zeta Retail. Their renewal on 31 Oct depends on a committed
date for saved cards for business buyers. Neha needs a yes, a no, or a date by end of day.
Reply to Neha with a realistic date. The B2B saved cards PRD (CHK-405) puts the earliest release in
Zeta Retail is asking for saved cards for B2B buyers before they renew. Can we commit to a
date? I need to reply by EOD Friday.
PRD: Saved cards for B2B buyers
Zeta Retail wants saved cards for B2B before renewal. It leaves
your radar and comes back on time.
